# SQL Data Analytics Project [![YouTube](https://img.shields.io/badge/YouTube-FF0000?style=for-the-badge&logo=youtube&logoColor=white)](https://www.youtube.com/@datawithbaraa) [![Udemy](https://img.shields.io/badge/Udemy-A435F0?style=for-the-badge&logo=udemy&logoColor=white)](https://www.udemy.com/course/sql-for-exploratory-data-analysis-eda-real-world-project/) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/datawithbaraa.com-111111?style=for-the-badge&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://www.datawithbaraa.com) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/DataWithBaraa/sql-data-analytics-project?style=for-the-badge&color=2EA043)](LICENSE) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/DataWithBaraa/sql-data-analytics-project?style=for-the-badge&color=F5B301)](https://github.com/DataWithBaraa/sql-data-analytics-project) The materials of the data analytics project: the data, every query from the videos, and the project roadmap. ⭐ If this project helps you, star the repository so other learners can find it too. You explore a sales database step by step, then go deeper with trends, segments and two full reports. **New here? Open the setup guide in the `00_setup` folder.** It walks you through installing SQL Server and creating the database, on Windows and Mac, with the fixes for the common errors. ``` sql-data-analytics-project/ ├── 00_setup/ the setup guide, and the one-click Docker start for Mac ├── 01_datasets/ the data, as a backup and as CSV files │ ├── DataWarehouseAnalytics.bak the database, ready to restore │ └── csv-files/ the same data, to build the database yourself ├── 02_docs/ the project roadmap and notes └── 03_scripts/ the queries, in the order of the videos └── 00_init_database.sql builds the database from the CSV files ``` Get the database in one of two ways: - Restore `01_datasets/DataWarehouseAnalytics.bak` in SSMS. It needs SQL Server 2022 or newer. - Or run `03_scripts/00_init_database.sql`. It builds the database from the CSV files in `C:\sql\sql-data-analytics-project\01_datasets\csv-files\`. The videos show the folders without numbers: `datasets` there is `01_datasets` here, `scripts` is `03_scripts`.

--- ## 🗺️ What you build ![The project roadmap](02_docs/Project%20Roadmap.png) The project has two parts, and the scripts follow them: - **Exploratory data analysis**, scripts `01` to `06`: you get to know the data, from the tables and dates to the big numbers and the top performers. - **Advanced analytics**, scripts `07` to `13`: you go deeper with trends, running totals, performance, part-to-whole and segments. Two reports close the project, one for customers and one for products. --- ## 🏆 Share your build Finished the project?
